set.pl: NE¼ sec 18 T3N R20E, Town of Dover; placed via the Mealy devisees' land, 1899 plat
pinev: 1899 plat: M. & A. Mealy strip, NE¼ sec 18 T3N R20E, Dover Twp (Mealy = Gregg's 1893 devisees); farmstead not marked; 1887 plate unread. Treasure rates the placement B-minus.
set.st: Mrs. Tony (Torena) Gregg of the Town of Dover died in Nov 1892 leaving $8,000 in a Mitchell bank and money hidden around the farm: $1,500 in a lard jar in the cellar, about $1,000 in rags, $1,000 in a pantry box, and more dug from the woodshed and outbuildings, nearly $18,000 in all. Her husband Wm. Gregg died in June 1893 aged 77 and willed the homestead to Thomas Mealy. Pin is on the Mealy land of the 1899 plat, not a spot.
